QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Is There Any Hope?
QuestInfo.0: The Lion King had been overcome by sadness and rage, which left him no choice but to join the Black Mage and seek revenge. Could his icy cold heart ever return to how it was? Talk to #b#p2161001##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161001# seems shocked at the past events that occurred at the castle, though she tries to hide it. She is determined to speak with the King herself and convince him. Use the #bSecret Path#k that only the King and Queen used to confront the Lion King.
QuestInfo.2: Has #p2161001# moved the Lion King's heart? The King never said he would stop helping the Black Mage. However, #p2161001# said there still is good in the Lion King's heart, and that she will do everything it takes to turn him back to the way he was.

0.0: Have you met someone who remembers the details of what happened? Who? #p2161002#... He was the captain of the king's knights. I didn't know he was still here... So, what did #p2161002# have to say? Did you learn what made Leon change so drastically?\r\n#L0##b(You explained everything you heard from #p2161002#.)#l\n#k
0.1: Yes...that's right. That day, thick, black clouds covered the sky, and a group of soldiers marched into our kingdom and attacked us. The castle walls crumbled and everything was in flames. And I was in the tower...filled with smoke...and that's what happened.\r\n#L0##b(Judging from #p2161001#'s reaction, #p2161002#'s story seems to be true.)#l\n#k
0.2: So that's why Leon changed. I resented Leon for everything that happened. But I know better now. I won't let him stay like this any longer.\r\n#L0##bDo you have a solution?#l\n#k
0.3: I am going to visit him myself. I couldn't go to him because of the monsters, but I can go now if you're willing to help me. Please, come with me to the Audience Room. I need your help!

1.0: I couldn't get him to abandon the Black Mage. He's changed so much... His cold eyes, and the way he spoke... He's nothing like the old Leon I knew. Revenge has taken his heart... Oh, isn't that...? Could I take a look at that pendant?

yes.0: This is the pendant I gave Leon as a gift. It was from my heart, in hope of seeing his wisdom grow as a king. He still had it. He is still a kind person, deep down.
yes.1: He's changed so much... And it may be too late for him to be forgiven. But I don't want to believe that it's hopeless. I'm going to believe that Leon will one day return to his old self.

item.0: Isn't there any way I can change his mind? If we leave him alone, he'll be forever lost in hatred towards humans as the Black Mage's servant. I can't allow that. Please, #bforfeit the quest and restart#k so we can meet him again.
